gaps.title: Mandatory institutional token or PIN authentication gate
gaps.jtbd: When an unauthorized user accesses the web application or API endpoints, I want a mandatory institutional token/PIN authorization barrier that blocks access with 401 Unauthorized, so that public access is fully isolated in compliance with 152-FZ.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given an unauthenticated session, When the user loads the application or requests API endpoints, Then an authorization modal requiring an institutional token/PIN is displayed and unauthenticated API calls return 401 Unauthorized until verified.
gaps.reason: literal brief requirement: Section 1 (Institutional security 152-FZ requires full isolation of public perimeter and mandatory token/PIN authorization screen with 401 responses on unauthenticated calls)

gaps.title: Elimination of technical paths, copy path buttons, and placeholder text in UI
gaps.jtbd: When viewing document cards and search results, I want human-readable titles, annotations, and direct download buttons instead of copy path buttons, raw file system paths, or 'database verified' stub responses, so that the UI provides clean document access without technical noise.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given the catalog UI and chat consultant, When browsing documents or receiving responses, Then no 'Скопировать путь' buttons or raw file paths are displayed, no 'по вашему запросу проверена база' stub text is output, and each document card provides direct DOCX/PDF download buttons.
gaps.reason: literal brief requirement: Section 2 (Elimination of copy path buttons, technical file paths, and stub responses in favor of human-readable titles and direct download)

gaps.title: Examination session schedule document generation for academic groups
gaps.jtbd: When scheduling examination periods, I want the document engine to generate official GOST-compliant examination schedules specifically for groups 25ОЭ, 26ОЭ, 25ОИ, 26ОИ, 25ОП, 26ОП and postgraduate students for the January 25 to February 25 session window, so that official examination schedules can be exported to DOCX in one click.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given a request to generate session schedules for groups 25ОЭ, 26ОЭ, 25ОИ, 26ОИ, 25ОП, 26ОП and postgraduate programs, When the generator is invoked, Then a GOST R 7.0.97-2016 compliant DOCX file covering the period 25.01-25.02 is produced with direct one-click download.
gaps.reason: literal brief requirement: Section 3.в (Examination session schedules for groups 25ОЭ, 26ОЭ, 25ОИ, 26ОИ, 25ОП, 26ОП and postgraduate students from 25.01 to 25.02)

gaps.title: Direct download links for normative corpus catalog documents
gaps.jtbd: When searching or browsing the 1,697 documents in the repository catalog, I want a direct download action on each document card, so that I can download the official document directly rather than only copying a local disk path.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given any document in the catalog of 1,697 records, When viewing the item in the UI, Then a functional direct download link/button is provided that serves the actual DOCX/PDF file.
gaps.reason: literal brief requirement: Section 4 (Catalog of 1697 documents of the institute with semantic search and direct download)
